mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12mo MA and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals accommodative monetary policy and increased economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and HOUST increases, but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases, but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand, leading to reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 < 12mo MA and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
